transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I know the flights are short and safe, but I have this intense, over-the-top fear of getting on a plane that’s now holding me back at work. I'm supposed to travel for management training, but I just can't do it, and it's putting my whole promotion in jeopardy.
When you think about flying, do you experience intense physical symptoms like a racing heart, sweating, or trembling, and do you actively avoid booking flights because of this fear?

Yes, absolutely. Even just seeing a picture of a plane makes my chest tighten, my heart pound, and my palms sweat. I'll drive six or seven hours to avoid a short flight, and the one time I actually tried to go, I froze up shaking at the gate and had to run away.
